== Biography ==

* Fact: Immigration (1850)  New York City, New York, United States
* Fact: Residence (1875)  Middletown, Richmond, New York, United States

William was born about 1822. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1702|James Glasgow]].  As of 1845 he lived at Ballynasollus.

On 7 Aug 1845 at Derryloran Church of Ireland (St Luran’s), he married Sarah Jane Gormley of Ballynagilly, Lissan, daughter of John Gormley. Witnessed by James Glasgow and David Gormley (brother).
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/ad34d03159526 William Glasgow, Sarah Gormley, 7 Aug 1845, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1702]] is assessed at 88% (probable). William’s 7 August 1845 Derryloran marriage names James Glasgow as father and gives William’s Ballynasollus residence. This strongly fits the selected local James and his later family network, with a retained warning about possible contemporary same-name families.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1845 father occupation/witnesses with James’s 1851 marriage.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/ad34d03159526 William Glasgow, Sarah Gormley, 7 Aug 1845, Cookstown (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/ad34d03159526) at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Father may be conflated, i.e. we are not certain that all the listed siblings of this profile are siblings; as opposed to two different families of James Glasgows.

There is a William Glasgow of Ballynasollus in the 1859 Griffith's Valuation.
